create_key_decorator: create a key decorator that marks functions with key codes for input handling
build_key_handler_metaclass: build a KeyHandler metaclass that maps key codes to handler methods on classes
register_class_with_keys: register a class with the KeyHandler metaclass to enable key-based input dispatching
handle_user_input_keys: handle user input by matching pressed keys to registered handler functions in a class
mark_multiple_key_handlers: mark a function with multiple key codes so it responds to several key presses
